name: Win11Debloat
description: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.

latest_release.name: Release 2026.10.30
latest_release.body:
> [!NOTE]
> Win11Debloat now stores user data, including your last used settings, preferences, and logs, in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Win11Debloat` instead of the script directory. The script will still fall back to the script directory when it is run in system context.

This release introduces one of the most requested features for Win11Debloat: localization support! Made possible by contributions from the community, the GUI now supports 13 languages. Special thanks to @SashankBhamidi for laying the foundation for this!

Beyond localization, this update brings several new features, expanded app removal support, and numerous improvements to the user interface, security, reliability, and performance.

## New Features & Enhancements

* Localization support
  * Add localization framework for the GUI (en-US baseline) by @SashankBhamidi in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/764
  * Add localization for app names and descriptions by @SashankBhamidi in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/769
  * Add Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) translation by @2ButAqUxVy in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/768
  * Add Dutch (nl-NL) translations by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/778
  * Add pt-BR app names and descriptions by @YWZsaXRv in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/781
  * Add Italian (it-IT) translations by @habby1337 in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/786
  * Add Japanese (ja-JP) translations by @willybilly981 in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/791
  * Add Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) GUI translations by @quanfanpro-code in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/799
  * Add Russian (ru-RU) GUI translation by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/857
  * Add Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) (zh-TW) GUI translation by @wang13zhe in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/838
  * Add Korean (ko-KR) GUI translation by @wang13zhe in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/842
  * Add German (de-DE) GUI translation by @wang13zhe in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/839
  * Add French (fr-FR) GUI translation by @wang13zhe in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/841
  * Add Spanish (es-ES) GUI translation by @wang13zhe in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/840
  * feat: add Turkish (tr-TR) UI translations by @kararliadam in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/845
* Add an option to disable Google Chrome AI features by @yasar11732 in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/763
* Add settings UI for theme and language by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/780
* chore: update Edge AI feature to also disable Copilot Chat button by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/811
* feat: update FriendlyNames and descriptions for various apps by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/861
* feat: Add support for removing the Windows App by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/863
* feat: Add support for removing additional OEM bloatware apps by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/864
* feat: add option to disable driver updates through Windows Update by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/870

## Other Changes & Fixes

* Allow home screen buttons to expand to fit localized labels by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/775
* Optimize installed app detection by @EvilGorilla13 in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/771
* Add warning to 'Hide Home' feature tooltips regarding Quick access links by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/779
* Add performance warning to Xbox Game Overlay descriptions by @Raphire in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/787
* fix(translations): add the missing en-US translation for DisableChromeAI by @HetCreep in https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/pull/797
